author: Shaz Moghaddam
lede: The official THE World University Rankings 2027 top 50, with where each university is and the fields it is best known for.

insights.text: Oxford is number one for a record 11th year in a row, ahead of MIT by just 0.1 points.
The US has the most universities in the top 50, and the US and UK fill the whole top 10.
Asian universities in the top 50 now outnumber those from continental Europe.
Imperial, UCL, King’s and LSE. LSE is back in the top 50 at 47th.

source: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027, published 30 September 2026. 2,297 universities ranked across 118 countries and territories, on teaching, research environment, research quality, industry and international outlook.
